SchemaVersion.description: SemVer of the contract. Consumers MUST reject a major they do not know.

Timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC with millisecond precision. Edge clocks are NTP-disciplined; see docs/03.

DeviceId.description: Stable identity of the edge unit, not the bus. A unit can be moved between buses.

Confidence.description: Calibrated probability, not a raw softmax score. See docs/03 on temperature scaling.

accuracy_m.description: 1-sigma horizontal error. Drives inverse-variance weighting during fusion.

source.description: gnss alone = the bus's position. +ipm = the detection's own ground position.

MapMatch.description: Result of snapping a GeoPoint onto the OSM road graph. The spatial key for every rollup.

offset_m.description: Distance along the segment from its start node.

lateral_m.description: Signed offset from centreline. Negative = left of travel.

EgoState.description: The bus's own motion at capture time, interpolated to the frame.

Conditions.description: Capture conditions. Fusion downweights poor conditions; a night 'not-seen' is weak negative evidence.

occlusion.description: Fraction of the road ROI blocked by other vehicles.

Evidence.description: Pointer to the stored crop. The frame itself never travels inside the message.

sha256.description: Chain of custody. Recomputed on ingest.

quality.description: sharpness x illumination x subject size. Picks the canonical crop during fusion.

faces_blurred.description: MUST be true for any crop containing people. Enforced on-device.

ModelProvenance.description: Which model produced this, on what runtime. Required to re-score history after a model upgrade.

DetectionClass.description: See docs/02-detection-taxonomy.md. Classes prefixed missing_ are NEVER emitted by the edge - they are inferred in the backend from SegmentPass negative evidence.
